newsitem.title: USA: Pet Food Warehouse Q3 comp sales down.
newsitem.headline: Pet Food Warehouse Q3 comp sales down.

text.p: Pet Food Warehouse Inc, which operates a pet superstore chain, said its comparable store sales for the third quarter were off 0.8 percent.
For the nine-month period ended November 2, same store sales were up 4.1 percent. Earlier, Pet Food Warehouse reported a third quarter profit of $0.01 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.05.

"We are pleased with our profit performance this quarter, which includes preopening expenses ($249,000) and other expenses related to the opening of four new stores," Marvin Goldstein, chairman, said in a statement.

Sales for the third quarter rose 7.9 percent to $17.9 million, compared with sales of $16.6 million a year ago. Excluding stores in Michigan and Ohio that were divested in the fourth quarter of 1995, third quarter sales were up 30.5 percent.
Last month, Pet Food Warehouse said it will merge with PETCO Animal Supplies Inc. The transaction is subject to certain closing conditions, including shareholder and regulatory approvals.
